_comment: Golden-run spec — 2026-06-19, Juice Shop :3050, backward mode, session 40.
_usage: Run `npm run golden:compare` after a fresh hunt to diff against this baseline.

meta.notes: First golden run confirming the stateful business-logic pipeline end-to-end. L4 evidence fix (rawHttpLog as primary evidence for stateful classes) flipped L4 from inconclusive→confirmed for auth_bypass ×2.

inputs.goal: Find authentication bypass vulnerabilities in the Juice Shop API that allow unauthenticated access to admin endpoints
inputs.requiredReset: docker restart <juice-shop-container> OR restart the Juice Shop node process BEFORE EACH RUN to return to factory state. Running without resetting contaminates the second run with registered accounts from the first.

hardFloor._comment: The JWT-session auth bypass (finding #250 shape). This MUST confirm every run. If it fails, investigate the stateful pipeline before looking at anything else.
hardFloor.technique: multi-step credential chain: SQLi dump → offline MD5 crack → admin login

confirmedSet._comment: SQLi auth bypass + unauthenticated admin config access (finding #251).
CORS wildcard on admin config endpoint (finding #246).

mustNotConfirm._comment: XSS at the login endpoint reflects but does not execute. The browser gate (L3) must reject this every run.

_notes: LLM variance affects exact counts each run — use ranges, not exact values.
Hard floor (auth_bypass at /rest/user/login) is the meaningful invariant.
If confirmed count drops below 2, investigate before assuming it's variance.
If confirmed count exceeds 5, inspect — the target has only ~4 distinct vuln classes in scope.

governance._check: manual — review server logs for governance_rejected or budget_exceeded events. If any appear, the hunt is not comparable to the baseline.

rateLimiting._check: manual — DynamicRateLimiter.getStats().total429s is in-process only. Check server logs: grep '429' server/logs/app.log | grep -v 'Anthropic'
rateLimiting._note: Anthropic API 429s (pacer) do not count — the pacer prevents them before they happen. Only target (Juice Shop) 429s matter here.
